name: Ujin
notes: Photo 1 shows the same MAIN food menu as photo 3 but blurrier/at an angle; photo 3 is a clear, well-lit close-up of the full food menu and was used as the primary source. Photo 2 is a drinks-only board (draft/import beer, saki, sodas/tea) and was skipped. Ramen dishes with multiple protein options (chashu/chicken, beef belly, wagyu) are listed as separate entries since each carries its own price. Topping add-ons (extra egg, extra noodles, etc.) were omitted as modifiers.
